selection_constraints: Do not select more than one final reviewer from the same disciplinary lane.
Do not select all final reviewers from one institution.
Do not contact a candidate with anchor content, constructor targets, rationales, contrast labels, or admissible score ranges.
Do not interpret silence, refusal, or referral as evidence about the instrument.
Do not replace a reviewer because their blind ratings are unfavorable.
Freeze compensation and review window uniformly before sending the first invitation.
